column3: Close to the Hebrew; “between the paths” is rendered “where the paths meet.”
Close to the Hebrew; כִּי־ נְגִידִים (“noble things”) is rendered “excellent things.”
Close to the Hebrew; מִפְּנִינִים (“than corals/pearls”) is rendered “than rubies.”
NKJV reads “All the judges of the earth,” following many manuscripts, where the Leningrad text has שֹׁפְטֵי צֶדֶק (“judges of righteousness”).
Close to the Hebrew; יֵשׁ (“substance, wealth”) is rendered “wealth.”
NKJV renders קָנָנִי (“acquired / created me”) as “possessed me.”
Close to the Hebrew; נִסַּכְתִּי (“set up, woven”) is rendered “I have been established.”
Close to the Hebrew; “his mouth” is rendered “His command.”
Close to the Hebrew; אָמוֹן (“a master workman / nursling”) is rendered “a master craftsman,” and “playing” “Rejoicing.”
